name: Paragons of Power: The Demoniac's Robes
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Demoniac's Robes: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The ultimate symbol of power amongst the tribe is the garb we wear in battle. A demoniac's robes have fused fine runecloth and devastatingly powerful mojo into a single fabric. The visage of the robe is said to instill fear into the minds of all who see it... Especially the demons that the demoniac will eventually dominate.
From Zul'Gurub, you must bring me a very specific set of the Paragons of Power. It will be difficult... But your success will assure you of acquiring a robe for yourself.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Paragons of Power... You have returned with them? Only once we have them will we share the ultimate symbol of demoniac power with you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Impressive - your victory in Zul'Gurub has assured us - nay, the world - that Hakkar will not prevail. The time may come when you face the Blood God directly... And should this come to pass know that your reverence is assured amongst the Zandalar tribe.
Oh, and this simple robe should help out too I think.
